rationale: A presents the most complete and production-plausible tri-fold system, with refined luxury-hospitality styling, strong romantic imagery, cohesive branding, clear panel hierarchy, and layouts that should translate well to both print and web images. D is the most immediately compelling proposal-focused concept but reveals less of the full brochure. E is polished and comprehensive, though its cover is less emotionally direct. C fulfills the tri-fold format but feels busier and less premium, while B appears closer to a single-page flyer and its playful headline weakens the luxury positioning.
uncertainty_notes: The small, angled mockups prevent reliable assessment of body-copy legibility, fold alignment, bleed, and the completeness of some designs—especially D. The brief excerpt is incomplete, so unknown copy, branding, and production requirements could affect the ranking.
